role: Manages SkillRegistry META_SCHEMA node for installed skill packages in Co-Being knowledge graph
detail: Defines the SkillRegistry bootstrap system which creates and manages a well-known anchor node (registry:skills) at the META_SCHEMA level. SkillRegistry tracks all installed skill packages, their metadata, dependencies via SKILL_REQUIRES edges, and installation state. Persists across all three-layer reset operations (anchor/skill/experience). Core functions: bootstrap_skill_registry() creates the registry node idempotently via GraphPersistence; get_skill_registry() retrieves it. Uses INFERENCE provenance with source_id "bootstrap" and confidence 1.0. SkillRegistry node properties include registry_name, status (ACTIVE), description, and serves as root of skill package hierarchy for clean uninstall via installed_by_skill property.
gotchas: None evident; idempotent design handles re-bootstrap; post-bootstrap validation ensures node persistence; exception handling wraps save failures with BootstrapError context.
